name: Night icons
description: Day and night (plan g-noc-grafika): pitch and torch goods, the "No torch" warning and the night-threat alerts for the HUD (wolves, thief, fire). 40 × 40 like the resource icons, exported as SVG and PNG at 1× and 2×.

variants.name: Plain icons
variants.notes: Pitch barrel · burning torch · out torch crossed in red · wolf head with amber eyes · hooded thief with a sack · burning roof.

variants.name: Round badges
variants.notes: The same pictures on a dark round badge; threats have a red ring so they read as alerts in the HUD.
